plan: An assassin support who hooks with his harpoon and executes low-health enemies.
aSurveiller: His R (Death From Below). He executes any enemy below a certain health threshold: when low on health, stay away from him.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his harpoon (Q) pulls the first enemy hit.
When you're low on health, back off: his R executes you once your health drops below a threshold.
Don't chase him into the fog: he heals when he isn't seen.
forces: Executes several enemies with his R.
Very mobile with his W and his E.
Heals when he disappears from view.
faiblesses: Gains no health from items: fragile.
Relies on his harpoon to engage.

sorts.P: Heals when unseen; his bonus health becomes damage.
sorts.Q: Harpoon that pulls an enemy or skewers them.
sorts.W: Becomes camouflaged and gains a lot of speed.
sorts.E: Dashes; a phantom comes back and stuns those it passes through.
sorts.R: Executes low-health enemies; can recast if he kills.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 2, and fearsome in fights from level 6.
